interest: Index on China retaining Gen. Yasuji Okamura for Japanese repatriation.
overview: 1947 telegram: China's government confirms Gen. Yasuji Okamura remains liaison officer overseeing Japanese surrender and repatriation, work needing more months.

people.name: Yasuji Okamura
people.role: General; chief liaison officer in connection with Japanese surrender and repatriation of Japanese troops

subfiles.about: Reports on Chinese Government statements regarding the whereabouts and repatriation liaison duties of General Yasuji Okamura.
subfiles.summary: Telegram No. 1333: Stuart reports China's spokesman confirms Gen. Okamura still leads Japanese surrender and repatriation, needing several more months.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1333 from Stuart (Nanking) on Status and Whereabouts of General Okamura
